description: This file contains utility functions for handling Python scalar objects within the PyTorch framework. It defines template functions to unpack scalar values from Python objects and store them into C++ data types, as well as load scalar values from C++ data types into Python objects. The functions are tailored for specific At::ScalarType enumerations and include handling for complex and specialized floating-point types.

methods.name: T unpackIntegral(PyObject * obj,const char * type)
methods.description: Template function that unpacks an integral value from a Python object, with special handling for Python floats and longs. It performs type checking and conversion based on the desired C++ type.

methods.name: void store_scalar(void * data,at::ScalarType scalarType,PyObject * obj)
methods.description: Stores a scalar value extracted from a Python object into a memory location based on the specified At::ScalarType. It uses appropriate unpacking functions and casts to perform the conversion.

methods.name: PyObject * load_scalar(const void * data,at::ScalarType scalarType)
methods.description: Loads a scalar value from a memory location and converts it into a Python object, based on the specified At::ScalarType. Supports various numeric and complex types.

ctags.name: load_scalar
ctags.pattern: /^inline PyObject* load_scalar(const void* data, at::ScalarType scalarType) {$/

ctags.name: store_scalar
ctags.pattern: /^inline void store_scalar(void* data, at::ScalarType scalarType, PyObject* obj) {$/

ctags.name: unpackIntegral
ctags.pattern: /^inline T unpackIntegral(PyObject* obj, const char* type) {$/
